description.value: Murray's Pizza and Pasta is a locally-owned chain with five Okanagan Valley locations, including this Summerland unit on Victoria Road North. Pizzas are hand-made with fresh dough and premium toppings baked in stone ovens, and the restaurant has built a strong following among both locals and travellers passing through. It makes a practical mid-ride meal stop for cyclists touring the South Okanagan corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Summerland location page confirms the address (1-13604 N Victoria) and provides a phone number (250-404-4241) that is absent from the OSM record. The shared menu page lists multiple vegetarian-friendly specialty pizzas (Garden, Euro Veggie, Popeye), and a testimonial on the Summerland page explicitly references gluten-free crust ('Great gluten free crust. Very tasty pizza!'), confirming dietary options. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill was found in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Phone number 250-404-4241 is present on the website but is missing from the OSM record and should be added.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An actively operating, locally-owned pizza restaurant in Summerland on a well-travelled South Okanagan cycling corridor; provides a solid meal-stop option with dietary-friendly menu items for touring cyclists.

Takeout.detail: OSM classifies this as fast_food; the Summerland page presents a downloadable menu with no mention of dine-in seating, consistent with a takeout-oriented pizza counter

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists vegetarian pizzas including Garden (mushrooms, onions, green peppers, black olives, tomatoes, pineapple), Euro Veggie (black olives, onions, feta, artichokes, tomatoes), and Popeye (fresh spinach, tomatoes, feta). Summerland testimonial confirms GF crust: 'Great gluten free crust. Very tasty pizza!'

wow_evidence: locally-owned chain with five Okanagan Valley locations
